summary.name: Strata Files
summary.one_liner: Strata is a free, open-source, native macOS file manager and Finder alternative with instant as-you-type search, live folder sizes, a disk usage map and dual-pane mode.
use_cases: find files quickly on a Mac
see what is using disk space
browse SFTP servers or S3 buckets
batch rename files by pattern or date
summary.what_it_does: Strata indexes the home folder and Applications so files can be searched as you type, with results appearing quickly once the index is built. Folder sizes are shown when a folder is opened and kept updated. It offers a Disk Usage map, Large Files and Duplicates views, and a command palette (⌘K) for folders, files and commands. Views include Icons, List, Columns, Gallery and Disk Usage, with an optional Dual Pane mode for copying, moving and comparing between two folders. Developer features include Git status per file, project scripts, rich previews, SFTP/S3 connections, and Docker/OrbStack container browsing.
notable: Native AppKit and Swift app with no Electron or web views
Privacy-focused: no accounts, tracking or cloud; index and history encrypted on disk
MIT licensed with public source code; installable via Homebrew cask
Undo for renames, moves, copies and deletions, even after restart
caveats: Requires a Mac with Apple silicon running macOS 26 Tahoe
Apple Intelligence summaries are optional; without it, fallback features are used
Full search and measurement of folders needs Full Disk Access, which is optional
